newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Nuinsa raises Isla Magica stake to 9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Nuinsa raises Isla Magica stake to 9 pct.

text.p: Spain's Nuevas Iniciativas del Sur (Nuinsa) said on Friday that it had agreed to raise its stake by 500 million pesetas in Isla Magica to nine percent.

Nuinsa, a business that groups the non-core activities of Sevillana de Electricidad, said it had signed an agreement with Isla Magica, which will run the theme park due to open in Seville in the middle of the year.
Nuinsa's increased stake in Isla Magica is in line with a policy of encouraging social and economic development in Andalusia.
